title.narrative: Integrated Solid Waste Management-Circular Economy Adaptation for Alternative Plastic Waste Solutions in Cotabato City, Philippines

description.narrative: The aim of the action is to contribute to improved solid waste management capacities of local government units, civil society organizations, and informal sectors by integrating best practices of circular economy in Cotabato City. The action will enhance mechanisms for Solid Waste Management in the identified LGUs by integrating gained knowledge in circular economy. Local CSOs and local communities will increase their understanding and ability to practice Solid Waste Management and Circular Economy integration.
